decisionQueue.emptyDescription: Decisions land here when they match the queue's rules or an agent adds them.
decisionQueue.adjustFilters: Adjust or clear the filters to see the rest.
decisionQueue.agingDescription: Idle past {{days}} days — kept off the queue. Keep any you still want surfaced.
decisionQueue.seedingOnDescription: This queue fills itself automatically. Decisions are added the moment they match any of its rules:
decisionQueue.seedingOffDescription: Automatic adds are paused. These rules would add decisions to the queue when on:
decisionQueue.disableHint: Turning it off stops new automatic adds only — decisions already here stay, and you can still add or remove decisions by hand.
decisionQueue.disabledHint: Adding or removing decisions by hand still works while automatic seeding is off.
